articles.title: Carbonato Botnet Compromises Docker Hosts to Deploy Telegram-Controlled Hermes AI Agent
articles.summary: Cybersecurity researchers have disclosed details of a new botnet malware called Carbonato that's targeting exposed Docker daemons to deploy an open-source artificial intelligence (AI) agent framework called Hermes Agent. articles.title: IA : la mise à l’écart d’Anthropic par le Pentagone confirmée par la justice
articles.summary: La cour d’appel de Washington a jugé conforme, vendredi, la mise à l’index de la start-up d’intelligence artificielle qui avait refusé, en février, de laisser l’armée américaine utiliser sans restriction son modèle, Claude.

articles.title: US Navy stands up hub to prepare unmanned systems for combat
articles.summary: U.S. Chief of Naval Operations Adm. Daryl Caudle announced a new autonomous development center to train sailors and test new technology.

articles.title: Thales in ‘quite advanced’ talks with NATO countries on AI-powered command software
articles.summary: French firm Thales is “quite advanced” in discussions with a number of NATO countries about using its artificial intelligence-powered C2 system.
